newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged; stable trend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged; stable trend seen.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against its U.S. counterpart on Friday amid a lack of market-moving factors. Dealers said they saw a stable trend ahead.
The local unit remained in a narrow range all session and closed at T$27.662, the same as Wednesday's close.
Turnover through dealers was a moderate US$206 million.
The market was closed on Thursday for a Labour Day holiday.
"The market simply wasn't moving today because there were no factors to move it," said one dealer.
A T$27.64-68 range was seen for Saturday.
